brief.en: Adjusts the angle and shoots stars in 5 directions
brief.zh: 调整角度并向五个方向发射星星

description.en: Angel Starfruits adjust the angles and then shoot stars in 5 directions.
description.zh: 天使星星果会调整角度，随后向五个方向发射星星子弹。

chat.en: Princess Angel Starfruit is far more energetic than Starfruit from a small town. Starfruit can't even be bothered to rotate himself a little.
chat.zh: 天使星星果公主比来自乡下的星星果有活力多了，星星果甚至连转个身都不愿意。

text.en: changes shooting directions according to zombies' coordinates
text.zh: 根据僵尸的位置改变发射的方向
